name: X-Energy, Inc.
blurb: X-Energy, Inc. is a nuclear reactor technology company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. Its flagship product is the Xe-100, a small modular reactor (SMR) designed to generate 80 megawatts of electric power or 200 megawatts of thermal output. The company also manufactures TRISO-X fuel, a high-assay low-enriched uranium pebble fuel designed for advanced reactors. With 889 employees and a market capitalization of approximately $12.2 billion, X-Energy is one of the leading pure-play SMR developers in the United States.
recent: X-Energy completed its IPO on April 24, 2026, making it one of the most closely watched nuclear energy listings of the year. The stock has traded in a range of roughly $29.45–$37.10 since its debut, closing at $30.99 on May 13, 2026 — a decline of 2.36% on the day, with pre-market weakness continuing into May 14. The company's next earnings report is scheduled for May 30, 2026; trailing twelve-month revenue stands at $94.26 million (+12.2% year-over-year) against a net loss of $389.78 million.
